note: Shops (Dave 2026-10-21). An NPC with an entry here can trade: a dialogue effect {"open_shop": true} opens the trade window. stock: items the trader sells (unlimited for now); buys: item kinds the trader will buy from the player, or "all"; title: the window title. Prices come from items.json value (copper) and data/items/coins.json trade. stock_rules: item id -> [most on the shelf, restock per game day]; purse_cap and purse_regen_per_day: the coin the trader can pay out (copper) and how fast it refills (data/items/coins.json trade.stock has the defaults).

hob.title: Hob's stall

wanted_orders.note: Hob's daily wanted order (Dave 2 Nov 2026, QA sal-wanted-orders A): one small order a game day, the same for everyone; each player can fill it once a day for a poor wage and 1 reputation. Ask him with "Any order for today?". The order of the day is orders[(day x 3 + 1) mod count].

hob.buy_rules_note: Dave 2 Nov 2026 (QA sal-lumber-vs-picking, C): Hob buys only a few boards a day, about two or three boards per copper (hardwood 2, softwood and plain 3; a beam 1 copper). per_day refills over a game day. Mission 001 (master s4 item 3): the species boards and beams are retired, so the rules are Plank (3 per copper) and Hardwood board (2 per copper).

skritch.note: Skritch of the Ragtooth goblins (data/creatures/goblin_tribes.json, Dave 19 Nov 2026: goblins "willing to communicate and trade/buy and sell"; trade in coins with the same window as Hob, answered for him 19 Nov 2026). What a goblin camp by a cave and a river has to hand: forage, cave stone, bones and what they make of them. Prices move with standing with the tribe (the whole tribe shares it). PROVISIONAL stock and limits (GOBLIN-5, docs/design/GOBLIN_CAMP.md).
